name: Visual Journalism
tagline: bang-motion's jurnalisme visual: black and grain, condensed Oswald titles, yellow highlighter, red for the fact that hurts.

motion.direction: bang-motion visual journalism. Black with grain; Oswald condensed 600–800 titles up to 112 px, IBM Plex Mono source tags under every `imageCard` (real photos only, with their source), a yellow `gold` highlighter mark drawn under the key word, red `ter` ONLY for the fact that hurts, dashed annotations (`focusRing`). Entrances slide in with a directional blur (scaleY 1.45 → 1, 0.8 s power4.out), exits up with blur 0.4 s; push-through transitions between sections; viewpoints change (never 3 same compositions in a row). Body ≥ 44 px, nothing under 30 px; sentence case for body, caps only in the one emphasis scene.
